content.text:
- **Use the installed CLI’s help as authority.** Current generic docs show `--project`, but Codex’s current source has no cwd/project filtering. Safer: produce Codex session JSON, then match session IDs to yyot session metadata. [Codex loader](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/blob/main/rust/adapters/codex/src/loader.rs)
- **Avoid double-counting cached tokens.** Current Rust JSON reports `inputTokens` as uncached input, separately from `cacheReadTokens` and `cacheCreationTokens`. Older packages may differ. [Accounting tests](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/blob/main/rust/adapters/codex/src/lib.rs)
- **Cost is an API-equivalent estimate.** It includes cached pricing and recorded Standard/Fast/Flex tiers; reasoning tokens are already included in output. Missing tier metadata falls back to current configuration. [Codex documentation](https://ccusage.com/guide/codex/)
- **Check `totals.unpricedModels` and `missingPricing`.** Unpriced usage is counted at $0, so an incomplete price catalog understates costs. [JSON documentation](https://ccusage.com/guide/json-output)
- Use **October 11, 2026, Asia/Kolkata** as cutoff. `--until` is inclusive; `--timezone` controls local dates. [CLI options](https://ccusage.com/guide/cli-options)

Suggested final caveat: “Estimated from retained local yyot coding logs; API-equivalent cost, not your subscription bill. Deleted, remote-only, or unlogged usage may be missing.”

content.text:
**v20.0.19 uses legacy replay heuristics, not explicit MultiAgent V2 boundaries.**

- It recognizes `forked_from_id` and the subagent parent ID. It removes matching parent usage prefixes, then uses a one-second burst heuristic if matching fails. It does not read `subagent_history_start_ordinal`, `multi_agent_version`, or `history_mode`. [Tagged replay source](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/blob/v20.0.19/rust/adapters/codex/src/replay.rs#L224), [parser](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/blob/v20.0.19/rust/adapters/codex/src/parser.rs#L177).
- Each migration file starts with a fresh cumulative baseline, but `last_token_usage` takes precedence. Your example initially contributes **182,294 tokens**, not **4,472,816**. [Tagged calculation](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/blob/v20.0.19/rust/adapters/codex/src/parser.rs#L320).
- **Focused session reports do not deduplicate across differently named migration files.** Their dedup key contains the filename-derived session ID. Daily/monthly reports omit that ID. A copied event can therefore appear twice in summed session results. Actual matching events are needed to establish whether and how much this affected the 2.15B result. [Tagged dedup key](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/blob/v20.0.19/rust/adapters/codex/src/aggregate.rs#L531).

I cannot establish an actual overcount from filenames/metadata alone. Also, the **2.31B counter estimate** needs inherited child baselines removed if those counters include parent history.
